change_from_v1: Adds a physically preregistered observer-centred Local-Volume mass gate. All Virgo, Coma, Local Void, Bootes Void, secondary-anchor, smoothing, and coordinate definitions are unchanged.
coordinate_frame: de Vaucouleurs supergalactic Cartesian, observer at box centre

local_void.note: The Local Void is a connected multi-basin complex, not one sphere. Coordinates are the published SGX/SGY/SGZ minima in km/s divided by 100, which is numerically Mpc/h.

bootes_void.note: The paper's 63 Mpc radius assumes H0=50 and is explicitly written as 31 h^-1 Mpc. P1 tests matter underdensity, not literal absence of galaxies.

observer_environment.purpose: Reject a cluster/group-scale Local Volume before selecting any LG pair
observer_environment.density_field: z=0 PM density with the unchanged 4 Mpc/h Gaussian smoothing
observer_environment.physical_interpretation: At R=5 and 8 Mpc/h these bounds exclude the tens-of-trillions Msun excess found around BGc seed 3003 while allowing a Local-Sheet-scale overdensity. They are fixed mass bounds, not percentiles fitted to the parent ensemble.
observer_environment.definitive_followup: No HOP/M200c halo above 5e12 Msun/h within 8 Mpc/h of the observer or promoted LG midpoint

hard_gate_policy.mass_and_velocity_status: Observer excess mass is a P1 proxy; halo M200c, contamination, and relative velocities are deferred to higher resolution

secondary_policy.status: blind validation only; never required for P1 pass and never used to retune hard gates
secondary_policy.note: Cluster anchors test the surrounding cosmography. Extended filaments and basins such as Perseus-Pisces and the Great Attractor require a later topology/velocity-field comparison rather than a single-point hard gate.
